decisions: 연결선은 hierarchy/steps/timeline/chart-line 등 전체 멤버를 가진 한 요소만 소유한다.
card base04, quiet06을 서로 다른 named design으로 고정한다. 제품 카탈로그 판은 line/tone 변형으로 끼워 넣지 않는다.
chart-stack의 base 원본은 계약 h 방향이다. 기본 세로 방향은 같은 선/채움 언어로 파생 설계한다.
replica의 겹친 머리글과 중복 chevron DOM도 그대로 측정하고 coverage에 포함한다.

reassembly_constraints.why: Cover contract explicitly has no head/body; no element slot exists for the mapped hl or partial frame. Fixed cover wordmark scale and inline top rule cannot reproduce the source.
reassembly_constraints.proposal: Allow a full-size cover body grid behind lockup, plus a named large wordmark typography role.

reassembly_constraints.why: Fixed 12×6 integer grid with 20px gaps quantizes independent measured source positions; panel widths and line breaks differ.
The source uses a very large rotated CONTENTS sidebar and a lower-right accent triangle; fixed furniture has no matching rotated title or corner triangle role.
The paired giant circular/oval page background is a distinct page-face geometry; the frozen single notched-panel foundation has no semantic variant for it.
The source has two separated notched page panels; frozen foundation has one page face with no declared split-page variant.
